## Activity

During October 2022, Central Eye Clinic recorded 172 captures. This represents the activity completed at the site during the reporting month. The capture total provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes. The activity recorded for the month is presented alongside the quality and grading results below.

## Image quality

Of the 172 captures, 0 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 0.0. These results indicate that all captures were available for assessment during the reporting period. Image quality performance was therefore recorded without any ungradable captures.

## Grading

Grading identified 37 referable results from the captures completed during October 2022. The median lag between capture and grading was 2. This measure summarises the usual interval for results to proceed through the grading process. Together, the referable result total and median lag provide the main grading indicators for Central Eye Clinic for the month.
